# What a force can do

<!-- STEP id="canoe" -->
Think about this: a canoeist pushes the water backwards with her paddle. Why does the canoe move forwards? And why does it go faster when she pushes harder? This chapter answers these questions.

<!-- STEP id="effects" -->
A force can start motion, as when you kick a ball. It can change the direction of motion, as when a bat strikes a ball. It can change the speed. It can also change the shape of an object, as when you squeeze a lemon.
